name: Marilena Chaui
shortBio: Brazilian philosopher of Spinoza, Merleau-Ponty, and democratic ideology critique who diagnosed Brazil’s foundational authoritarian myths and defended public cultural autonomy.
centralQuestion: How do foundational national myths conceal structural authoritarianism, and how does Spinozist immanence ground radical democracy?

keyWorks.title: Cultura e Democracia: o discurso competente e outras falas
keyWorks.description: Critiques technocratic "competent discourse" and develops a philosophy of democratic cultural citizenship.

keyWorks.title: A Nervura do Real: Imanência e Liberdade em Espinosa
keyWorks.description: Monumental interpretation of Spinoza’s ontology of immanence and political freedom.
